questionText: Using the laws of logarithms, write $\log_{10}(8) + \log_{10}(5) - \log_{10}(4)$ as a single logarithm, and hence evaluate it.
markingScheme:
Apply log-addition law: $\log_{10}(8 \cdot 5)$ **(1 mark)**
Apply log-subtraction law: $\log_{10}\!\left(\tfrac{8 \cdot 5}{4}\right) = \log_{10}(10)$ **(2 marks)**
Evaluate $\log_{10}(10) = 1$ **(1 mark)**

solutionSteps.step: Combine the sum using the log-product law
Combine the difference using the log-quotient law
